description: Rename the site slug (public hostname {slug}.dotsy.site). Owner-only. After success: use the returned slug in every later tool. Published site: the old slug redirects on the API (301 for reads, 308 for writes) while it stays reserved; the old host 301s and stays reserved until delete or rename-back. Never published: the old slug 404s on the API and the old hostname is released (no 301; create_site can reuse it). Stored HTML URLs are not rewritten (use find_replace).
name: rename_site
